notes: Official Domino's UK CDN (dominos.a.bigcontent.io). Values are whole-pizza (e.g. Absolute Banger 2512 kcal / 114.4g protein). Sibling static paths may exist for sides/desserts - not yet enumerated. ADAPTER: scripts/scrapers/chains/dominos.py now yields 1331 rows (not 87) - it derives the name/number split per table as min(header col indices), carries names forward across grouped rows, and decodes the 90-degree-rotated cheese column, so the previously nameless rows are recovered. Basis is whole pizza for the pizza tables (the Per Pizza block is bound, not Per Slice).
